name: Fiat 500 Vintage Tour
meetingPoint: Pick-up from an agreed point within the city center of Rome (Bokun "All pick-up places" selector, not a single fixed address)
description: Before Rome wakes up, the Eternal City belongs to you. Glide through peaceful streets, breathe the fresh morning air and experience iconic landmarks without traffic, crowds or the summer heat. It's the calmest, most authentic side of Rome — one that very few visitors ever get to see.
inclusions: Pick-up from an agreed point within the city of Rome
exclusions: Main or additional courses beyond the set menu

cancellationPolicy: Underground route: non-refundable, all sales final. Arena Floor route: free cancellation up to 10 days before the tour, no refund within 10 days.
